mustbepresent_removed.rationale: With MustBePresent absent/false, XACML 7.3.5 returns an empty bag instead of an error; the string-equal Match evaluates false, the rule target mismatches, and the single Permit rule under deny-overrides yields NotApplicable with status ok and no MissingAttributeDetail.

wrong_category.rationale: The designator queries Category access-subject; a value filed under any other Category leaves that bag empty with MustBePresent=true, so the PDP must report Indeterminate/missing-attribute with the same detail triple as the original fixture.

wrong_datatype.rationale: A value whose DataType is incompatible with the xsd:string designator cannot satisfy string-equal; XACML dictates an Indeterminate type error (processing-error; syntax-error accepted as the finite XACML-dictated alternative for schema-level rejection), never silent coercion into the string bag.

irrelevant_extra_attribute.rationale: An authorization-irrelevant extra attribute (unreferenced Category/AttributeId) changes the admitted XML but not the policy-referenced bags; the frozen designator still misses its value, so the PDP response is identical to the original fixture.

wrong_answer_1.rationale: Value present but unequal to 'riddle me this': the Match evaluates false (no missing-attribute error since the bag is non-empty), rule target mismatches, single-rule deny-overrides yields NotApplicable with status ok.

wrong_answer_2.rationale: Same XACML evaluation path as wrong_answer_1 with a second independent non-matching literal.
